summary: Frontend-only end-to-end verification of the new portfolio shell (Hero identity + floating featured card, 4-link Navbar, Projects asymmetric grid with Cobot Flagship, Timeline 5 items, About Me focus/credentials/contact, fixed Resume module + mobile toggle, Footer + toast, preserved light Cobot case study, mobile 390x844 layout). All 13 review-request items PASS. Zero console errors, zero broken images, no 'Carlos Sierra' anywhere.
critical_code_review_comments: PROFILE.linkedin still points to 'https://www.linkedin.com/' root (no username) — pre-existing content nit carried from earlier iterations, non-blocking.
Hero.jsx uses Math.abs()-based section detection in Navbar; works fine but section IDs 'home', 'projects', 'timeline', 'about' are all present, so active-underline logic is stable.
ResumeModule exports RESUME_URL=null; Footer relies on it to show toast — clean coupling but consider moving RESUME_URL into portfolio.js data module in future for single source of truth.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL https://robotics-portfolio-17.preview.emergentagent.com. Test IDs verified working: hero-featured-card, hero-featured-chip, hero-centerpiece (src=/projects/cobot/IMG_6125.jpg, naturalWidth=900), navbar with nav-home/projects/timeline/about + nav-mobile-toggle + nav-mobile-*, project-card-cobot-ultrasonic-welding-automation (Flagship, opens LIGHT cobot-case-study rgb(244,241,236)), project-card-gripper-fixture/faro-fairino-reliability/cad-3d-printing (open DARK modal rgb(15,23,42)), timeline-item-0..4 (5 items), credential-0..2 (3 'coming soon' cards, no fake certs), about-email=mailto:Carlossibaja18@gmail.com, resume-module (desktop-only, bottom-left, 'RESUME PDF COMING SOON' + 'Scan or View PDF ↗', no live link), resume-mobile-toggle (mobile-only, expands panel with same content), footer-resume (href='#', clicking triggers sonner toast 'Resume coming soon'). CSS text-transform:uppercase means 'Featured Project'/'Coming Soon' appear in DOM as ALL-CAPS — case-insensitive text assertions recommended. Lenis smooth-scroll active, use wait ~1200ms after nav clicks before checking scrollTop. All 4 project modals close via modal-close-btn / Escape / scrim. Cobot preserved case study still renders 8 /projects/cobot/*.jpg images in order (verified in iteration_5, spot-checked here). No console errors.
